stem: Voltmarkt measures Business Care lead conversion by cohort month: a cohort is counted at every stage its leads reached, whenever they reached it. Of the 150 leads created in May 2025 from partner referrals, 66 have reached MQL so far, and 30 of those have reached SQL. During May itself, the CRM recorded 58 MQL dates and 27 SQL dates for partner leads created in any month. What is the May cohort's MQL to SQL conversion? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
